name: Feedback templates (starter)
description: Question banks and feedback templates for exit interviews (employee, manager, HR), confirmation, probation self-review and induction evaluation.

question_banks.name: Exit interview questions
question_banks.description: Questions for exit interviews by the employee, the manager and HR.

questions.title: What is the main reason you are leaving?
How would you rate your role overall?
How would you rate the support from your manager?
Would you consider rejoining in the future?
What should we improve?

question_banks.name: Probation and confirmation questions
question_banks.description: Questions for confirmation feedback and probation self-reviews.

questions.title: Job knowledge and skills
Quality of work
Attendance and punctuality
Teamwork and communication
Comments
Rate the induction sessions overall
I know whom to approach for help
What would have made the induction better?

feedback_templates.name: Exit interview
feedback_templates.description: The employee's own exit interview: why they leave, how they rate their time here, what to improve.

questions.title: What is the main reason you are leaving?
How would you rate your role overall?
How would you rate the support from your manager?
I would recommend this organisation as a place to work
Would you consider rejoining in the future?
What did you value most here?
What should we improve?

feedback_templates.name: Exit interview by the manager
feedback_templates.description: The manager's view of the exit: the reason, the handover and whether to rehire.

questions.title: In your view, what is the main reason the employee is leaving?
Was the resignation expected?
Rate the employee's overall performance
Would you rehire this employee?
Knowledge transfer and handover plan
Could the exit have been prevented? How?

feedback_templates.name: Exit interview by HR
feedback_templates.description: HR's exit conversation: the reason, concerns raised, retention and rehire.

questions.title: Reason for leaving, as discussed
Was a retention offer made?
Did the employee raise a concern (conduct, harassment, policy)?
Is the employee eligible for rehire?
Notes from the conversation

feedback_templates.name: Confirmation feedback
feedback_templates.description: The manager's assessment at the end of the probation, before the confirmation decision.

questions.title: Job knowledge and skills
Quality of work
Attendance and punctuality
Teamwork and communication
Your recommendation
Comments

feedback_templates.name: Probation self-review
feedback_templates.description: The employee's own review of the probation period.

questions.title: How well do you understand what is expected in your role?
I have the training and tools I need
Your main achievements during the probation
Where would you like more support?

feedback_templates.name: Induction evaluation
feedback_templates.description: How the new joiner's induction went (given by the joiner or the manager).

questions.title: The induction explained the organisation, its policies and my role clearly
Rate the induction sessions overall
I know whom to approach for help
Was everything ready on day one (laptop, access, workplace)?
What would have made the induction better?
